title: VRF Sortition
summary: A method in SORA Nexus for drawing validator committees where candidates prove via VRF that their random output meets a threshold, ensuring fair and unpredictable selection.
definition: A method in SORA Nexus for drawing validator committees where candidates prove via VRF that their random output meets a threshold, ensuring fair and unpredictable selection.
tagline: Prevents validator collusion by making committee selection unpredictable until the moment of reveal.
